children: Delek US finalized a financing package anchored by a $460 million private offering of 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, executed under a new indenture and guaranteed by certain subsidiaries. The notes carry an initial conversion price of about $85.31 per share and mature on November 1, 2031. To mitigate dilution, Delek entered capped call transactions initially capped at roughly $117.09 per share. Net proceeds of about $449.1 million will fund the capped calls and general corporate purposes, including partial repayment of the company’s term loan, supported by a purchase agreement with representatives of the initial purchasers.

Agreement 2: Delek US Adds Capped Calls, Lifting Effective Conversion Cap to About $117.09 Per Share

: Purchase agreement for private offering of convertible notes
